summary: New feature set (username+PIN auth, server-side scoring with time decay, reveal-forfeits, leaderboard, live timer, v2 persistence) exercised: 4 backend test files (8 tests incl. 1 updated pre-existing suite) + 1 updated old generation test + 8 named browser checks (one also re-run through the public preview URL).
